newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Hwan Yung Steel shares hit limit low.
newsitem.headline: Hwan Yung Steel shares hit limit low.

text.p: Shares of Hwan Yung Steel Industry Co Ltd fell 490 won to their daily limit of 5,710 won in Tuesday's late morning trading on talk that the company faced a final deadline to repay debts, brokers said.
The Korea Stock Exchange later suspended trading in Hwan Yung shares, citing rumours about the company's financial problem.
"Hwan Yung shares fell sharply after news came out that the company failed to pay back promissory notes on Monday," said Yoo Nam-gil of Hyundai Securities.
An official at Chung Chong Bank, one of Hwan Yung's creditor banks, said Hwan Yung failed to pay back 590 million won in debt on Monday.
Hwan Yung is faced with a final deadline by the end of Tuesday to repay the debt, he said.
Hwan Yung officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
